$comment: CLAUDEX W-SITE: single source of truth for the site URL layout (web plan section 3). Read by internal/web/sitepaths (Go dispatch and security headers) and by the web app route tests (W-ROUTE). Paths are matched exactly, or by prefix for the prefixes lists. Legacy redirects are 302, never 301.

bypass.$comment: Served by Go routes, never by a SPA (shouldBypassEmbeddedFrontend).

console.$comment: The Vue admin console (Vite base /admin/, assets under /admin/assets/).

console_root_pages.$comment: Public pages still rendered by the console index at the site root (released desktop builds, emails and third-party callbacks link to them).

legacy_redirects.$comment: Old console paths, 302 to their /admin location with the query kept.

admin_login_redirect.$comment: /login belongs to the web app; only a login for a console page moves to the console.
